instruction: Candid outdoor portrait, medium close-up. In a wooded park during autumn, the woman in the black puffer jacket and mint beanie (R1) looks directly at the camera with a playful, open-mouthed expression. She carries the smiling toddler girl in the pink turban beanie (R2) piggyback on her back, who also looks toward the camera. The background features soft-focus trees and warm autumn foliage under natural daylight.
